title: Add null escape hatch for FileNode sha256 on legacy data
description: §3 (line 175-181) says for file FileNodes server MUST set sha256 to the blob digest — no null is permitted for file nodes. But servers enabling this capability after-the-fact will have pre-existing FileNodes where the digest was never computed and stored. Currently a server cannot return null for a file FileNode even when the digest is genuinely unavailable, causing compliance failures on any server with pre-existing FileNode data. Add a null escape hatch for file FileNodes where digest is unavailable, with a note distinguishing from directory null.
